# Production

- Cost
  - Reasoning queries (∼5,000 output tokens) raise energy use ∼13× vs. standard queries ([source](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2542435126001145?utm_source=chatgpt.com))
  - Hosted Model: input tokens × input-token price + output tokens × output-token price
    - Reasoning causes the model to generate many more internal/output tokens (e.g. 1000s). Then, the API provider can charge substantially more.
- Track per-step accuracy separately from overall task completion.
  - When per-step accuracy drops from 90% to 87% on a 10-step task, overall success rate drops from 35% to 24%.
  - You want to catch that degradation in monitoring, not in a post-incident review
- The Docker Model Runner (DMR) - A new Docker Desktop feature that enables the run of Large Language Models natively with Docker Desktop.
  - Follows the common Docker workflow:
    - Pull models from registries (e.g., Docker Hub)
    - Run models locally with GPU acceleration
    - Integrate models into the development workflows
